text:
anya: Nightly eval flagged the pset pack v10 rebaseline — noticeable regression on negation and a couple format tests. dropping ~4.5% F1 on pset_negation. artifacts: https://ci.redwood/artefacts/pset-v10/1767312468 :eyes:

eval-bot: nightly-eval summary
model: redwood-33b-quant2
baseline: pset_v9 -> candidate: pset_v10
changed_prompts: 6
metrics: Negation_F1: 0.918 -> 0.876 (-4.5%), Date_FMT_acc: 0.993 -> 0.973 (-2.0%)
artifacts: https://ci.redwood/artefacts/pset-v10/1767312468/results.json

kyle: I pulled the artifacts and can repro locally with the same model and seed. looks like prompt id 31/76 that we edited to add `Prefer concise answer` is trimming clarifying followups and degrading negation handling.

anya: snippet of the prompt diff that caused concern:
```diff
--- pset_v9/prompts/prompt_031.txt
+++ pset_v10/prompts/prompt_031.txt
@@ -1,6 +1,7 @@
-You are an assistant that explains code examples. Provide step-by-step answers.
+You are an assistant that explains code examples. Provide step-by-step answers.
+Prefer concise answers unless the user asks for detail.

 Example: ...
```

marta: can we bisect by applying only the 6 changed prompts on top of v9 and rerun the failing buckets? should be faster than full rebaseline.

lee: proposed quick plan: 1) revert main to pset_v9 for nightly (stop the noisy regressions). 2) open hotfix PR that isolates the 6 prompt edits and runs targeted ablation. 3) once we identify offending prompt(s) we either tweak wording or keep them out of the rebaseline until manual signoff. anyone object? :thinking_face:

kyle: +1. i'll open the PR and include the per-prompt diffs + a short eval table. will tag @product-ops for rebaseline approval if we decide to keep changes.

product-ops: please include a small set of representative user cases and the before/after generative examples. we need to justify a rebaseline if it's going to change expected outputs for customers.

anya: example failure case from the run:
Input: "Did the code not log the error?"
Expected: "No, the log call is missing — add `logger.error(...)` in the except block."
Bad output (v10): "No. Add fewer words."
(This shows the concise preference truncated the actionable hint)

kyle: created PR https://git.redwood/psets/pull/1423 and rolled back pset on main. CI for nightly re-run kicked off: https://ci.redwood/runs/1767312700

eval-bot: nightly re-run started (pset_v9 restored). preliminary: Negation_F1 now 0.919 (within expected).

marta: confirmed repro for the problematic prompt. i'll run ablation tomorrow to pinpoint whether it's prompt_031 or an interaction with prompt_052.

lee: ownership notes: @kyle -> PR + changelog, @marta -> per-prompt bisect and ablation, @anya -> coordinate product signoff if we keep changes. let's continue discussion in PR #1423 and track sample cases there. closing here. :white_check_mark:
